item.title: Senegal seeks suspect's return from Mauritania
item.description: Alioune Badara Gaye, sought in Astou Pierre Ndiaye's acid attack death, arrested in Mauritania.

item.title: Two men die in car and motorcycle crash
item.description: A 33-year-old mechanic is in police custody after a collision near Auchan Castors on Sunday, November 1, 2026.

item.title: Senegal hosts Islamic Peace Forum in Thiès
item.description: The 24th edition of the Islamic Peace Forum opened on November 1, 2026, in Thiès, Senegal.

item.title: Senegal lioncels thrash Fiji 8-1 in youth games futsal opener
item.description: The Senegalese women's futsal team leads group A after their dominant victory, with Marème Niang scoring four goals.

item.title: Senegal launches national cloud infrastructure with Alibaba
item.description: The technology, developed for Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, will become a national platform after the event.
